_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v543_dual_decoder_50k/plan/budget_policy.json (plan §8.3 / §12 WP7 / ADR-0034 §4). WP0 ships PRE-PROFILE: every per_decoder entry is null with status pending_wp7_profiling; the prereg validator passes (the null table is a t1_blocked reason only) while --formal is the typed block V543_BUDGET_NULL. Fill each entry from the same-env WP7 smoke(200)/diagnostic(2,000)/profile(40+40) measurement BEFORE formal T1 and re-hash into budget_policy_sha256. The fixed dose 37,900 updates (flat, 400 warmup) is immutable. The cost denominator is the same-env V543 M0/P0 measurement — never the archived V542/V541 per-candidate core time.
_t1_block_rule: per_decoder.*.approved_for_formal must all be true for the admitted formal decoders before formal T1; the validator refuses --formal while budget.per_candidate_core_time is null (V543_BUDGET_NULL) and rejects malformed/partial tables (V543_BUDGET_INVALID)

activation_summary.t5_note: T5 takes at most the 2 frozen finalists per track (MOVE top1/top2, PROCESS top1/top2); unactivated rows are gate_skipped and count 0 new trainings
activation_summary.conditional_flow_diffusion_gru: M4/M5/P5 and T8 have their own identity, budget and report; activation requires a new signoff
activation_summary.diagnostic_2000: T2 2,000-update engineering screens for the 7 formal decoders are technical measurements (not N_core)

parameter_budget.assertion: 构造时 sum(p.numel()) 精确断言; 估算值不得作为实现前 exact 断言; dead weights / 无用 bias 凑参数禁止

cost_acceptance.denominator: same V543 environment, same batch, same 40+40 profile measured M0/P0 (Encoder frozen)
cost_acceptance.on_exceed: gate_skipped_cost_ratio_exceeds_2 — scientific result retained, no promotion, baseline stays (NOT resource_failure); no frame/layer/update reduction to 'fix' cost

cost_model.formula: T_run = 37900 * t_update + 400 * t_warmup_update + T_startup + T_eval + T_checkpoint
cost_model.encoder_frozen_note: Encoder 每当前构型恰好 1 次 forward; 冻结表征可走 frozen_encoder_only 缓存, cache miss 时 live fallback
cost_model.measure_note: Decoder-only: 无 W0/W1 两阶段语义; profile 记录 warmup 段与稳态段, 不得把 200-update smoke 外推到正式剂量

M1.toy_size_note: Residual MLP with 8 scalar coefficients over key_v (~36.6K design point; exact count asserted at construction)

M3.toy_size_note: 2-layer scalar-vector message passing on the key graph, hidden 56, edge features 8 (~34.5K design point)

P2.toy_size_note: DeepSets over key/pair tokens 48->88 + mean/max pooling + graph_s concat (~35.7K design point); must use the shared token layout

P3.toy_size_note: 2-layer latent Graph-GNN on the shared token graph, hidden 56, edge features 8 (~34.5K design point)

P4.role: T3/T4 formal candidate (highest cost risk — early profile)
P4.toy_size_note: 2-layer graph transformer d=48, 4 heads x 12, FFN 80 (~37K design point); token-level attention only

P4-C.role: parameter-matched non-attention control (diagnostic, only if P4 enters the top2)

P5.role: conditional (GraphGRU, activation only on a systematic PROCESS failure)

schedule.flat_note: 37,900 flat + 400 warmup; no W0/W1 phase split in Decoder-only training
schedule.fixed_dose_note: 正式训练始终固定 37,900 updates；fixed-GPU-time 只作另报成本匹配分析，不替代同剂量主比较

n_core_note: N_core = 7 (T3 seed17) + 7 (T4 seed29) + activated T5 finalists (<=4) <= 18 formal runs; 18 x 37,900 = 682,200 updates. smoke/diagnostic/profile are technical measurements excluded from N_core.
